rationale: C05 is a near-verbatim predecessor using the same operative sequence, the same Senate Committee on Government Operations, the same stated purpose, the same Treasury Decisions 6132 and 6133, and the same effectiveness clause. The child principally updates the tax-return years and Congress while omitting two obsolete return categories. C17 and C21 are earlier iterations of the same recurring template, but C05 is chronologically closest and already contains the precise Treasury-decision language reproduced in the child.
